title: Path traversal in /note allows reading files outside notes/
body: getNote() in server.js builds the file path by concatenating the user-controlled `name` parameter directly onto the notes directory with no normalisation. Supplying a traversal sequence escapes the notes directory and reads arbitrary files. PoC: GET /note?name=../secret.txt returns the contents of secret.txt, which lives outside notes/. Affected file: server.js, function getNote. CWE-22.
